title: The Malindi Geometric Dashiki Long-Sleeve Tunic Shirt
description: Elevate your everyday and cultural wardrobe with this striking long-sleeve tunic shirt, designed to bring together heritage-inspired patterns and clean modern tailoring. Crafted from smooth, structured fabric, the shirt features a rich navy and cream horizontal geometric motif composed of alternating linear bars, triangles, and hatched block bands. Tailored with long sleeves, a comfortable round crew collar, and an extended tunic hemline, it offers a polished drape that pairs effortlessly with tailored trousers or casual dark denim. Whether dressed up for celebrations and cultural events or styled casually for relaxed weekends, this piece delivers distinct artistic character and lasting comfort.
